name: gateway_run_collect_auto_append_media_tags
notes: Auto-append MEDIA tag collection from current-turn tool results. Harness is a traced copy of run_pure2.c::gw_collect_auto_append_media_tags (libjson-linked); twin drives the LIVE gateway/run.py::_collect_auto_append_media_tags with history_offset=0 and an empty dedup set. Outcome-level ladder only (B1 non-array, per-tag V events, B2 voice directive): the C port scans every tool/function message with a naive token scan while LIVE layers a producer-tool allowlist via tool_call_id->name mapping and an extension-anchored regex. DOCUMENTED DIVERGENCES (inputs excluded): non-allowlisted tool names, relative or extension-less MEDIA tokens longer than 4 chars (C accepts, LIVE regex rejects), assistant-role MEDIA text paths in the history collector shape, image_generate JSON-payload fields (LIVE-only path), nonzero history_offset / dedup-set behavior (C ignores both arguments). All gated inputs keep every tool message tied to an allowlisted producer and use extension-anchored absolute paths, where the two implementations agree on tags, order, duplicates, and the voice flag.
